Test image shows: whole-plant collapse in center with severely wilted, brown/tan leaves and yellowing, surrounded by healthy green plants. This pattern — localized plant death with interveinal yellowing on adjacent leaves — points to a root/stem rot disease causing whole-plant death.

Top candidates: Sudden_death_syndrome (interveinal chlorosis + root rot → plant death), Phytophthora (whole plant wilt/collapse), Brown_Stem_Rot.

The SDS reference shows classic interveinal necrosis — green veins with brown/tan tissue between them. The test image shows advanced-stage disease with whole-plant collapse and wilting, plus yellowing on adjacent plants consistent with SDS progression (root rot leading to complete plant death). The pattern of localized plant death surrounded by healthy plants, with some leaves showing yellow-brown interveinal symptoms, fits SDS well.
